title: # Agent work map: what each agent is building + its history, with progress meters Brett (Nov 1 2026…
asked: # Agent work map: what each agent is building + its history, with progress meters Brett (Nov 1 2026). Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/THREADS.md first. ## Ask In the Breakroom (agent swarm, profile `breakroom`), opening an agent shows: 1. **Working on now**: its current build(s)/steps, each with a progress meter (steps done / total, current step name, live state), tap to open the build in the Steps view. 2. **History**: every build/step/job run it ever did, newest first, with outcome (done/landed/failed/stopped), dates, duration, cost if known, commit/PR links, progress meter per build. 3. A small overview "map" across all agents: one row per agent, its current build + meter, so Brett sees who's on what at a glance. ## Data: NO new datasets Read only from what already exists: the one builds store (urgent-builds), orchestrator profiles, agent-swarm leases/statuses, agent-jobs run records (job-type@1, jobs.mjs / framework/cli/agent-job.mjs), build logs index, approvals log if useful. If a link between an agent and a build/step isn't recorded today, add the minimal field to the EXISTING record (e.g. agent id on lease/run/step) with a migration + fixture, not a new store. Backfill what can be derived from existing records. ## Reuse + dependencies - Build the meter + agent-work list as shared framework controls / assets (reading scale tokens), so other plugins (Build manager, Builds page, Steps view, AmberX) can use them. - Any plugin that uses them declares the dependency in its plugin.json requirements; fold the new pieces into the requirements of the plugins that rely on them (agent-swarm, agent-jobs, build-orchestrator, etc.) and keep plugin-lifecycle checks green (a plugin names only its own folder; uninstall stays clean). - Coordinate with the running build `builds-one-page-finish` (same store): don't change the store shape it relies on; if you must, keep it backward compatible. ## Rules Framework controls + hot-swappable assets; handwritten code only if it conforms. Phone-first, compact one-line rows, expandable rows (caret far right). Orchestrator build `agent-history` in profile `breakroom`, steps <= 30 min. Tests, lifecycle + theme checks, phone + desktop screenshots, report `_claude/builds/reports/agent-history.md`, THREADS row, STATUS. ## Landing Commit on this branch, merge origin/main (notes files keep both sides), push the branch. Do NOT push to main; Brett's session lands it with build_land. Never print secrets. End with a short report: what's on screen, where the data comes from, which plugins gained the dependency. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
